settings.pageDescription: Manage global configuration for your store.
settings.themeDescription: The site's brand colors. Changes apply everywhere immediately — no rebuild or redeploy needed.
settings.accentGoldDesc: Buttons on hover, badges, dividers, links.
settings.accentDeepDesc: Text on light backgrounds (needs more contrast than Gold).
settings.lightSurfaceDesc: Page background, light text on dark surfaces.
settings.hidePricesDesc: When enabled, product prices and checkout totals will be hidden across the entire store. Users will see a "Contact for price" message instead.
settings.enablePopupDesc: Show a promotional popup to visitors. It appears once per session.
settings.showOnDesc: Choose which pages the popup appears on.
settings.popupMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Explore our new arrivals and get free shipping on your first order.
settings.imageUrlDesc: Add a banner image at the top of the popup. Leave empty for text-only.
settings.allowMultipleDesc: When enabled, every currently-active seasonal collection shows on the homepage. When disabled, only the highest-priority one (by Display Order) is shown.
settings.sectionPositionDesc: Where the Seasonal Collection section appears among the homepage's fixed sections.
settings.newBadgeDaysDesc: Products added within this many days show a New badge automatically. Set 0 to turn the automatic badge off (the per-product switch still works).
settings.countdownDesc: Set an end time to turn this pop-up into a timed offer with a live countdown. It disappears on its own when the time is up.
settings.offerEndsAtDesc: Your local time. Leave empty for a regular pop-up without a timer.
settings.offerExpiredNote: This time is in the past — the offer is hidden from the site until you set a new end time.
settings.showOfferBar: Show countdown bar at the top of the site
settings.showOfferBarDesc: A thin bar above the header keeps the deadline visible after the pop-up is closed.
settings.popupTurkishDesc: Shown to visitors browsing in Turkish. Empty fields fall back to the English text.
settings.giftEnabledDesc: Shows the gift in the top strip, trust badges, the promo card and the cart progress bar. Turn off to hide it everywhere.
settings.giftThresholdDesc: Orders at or above this amount get the gift.
settings.tgDescription: Get every new website order instantly in Telegram, plus a summary every evening at 21:00. Connect as many people or groups as you like.
settings.tgNotConfigured: The bot is not set up yet.
settings.tgStep1: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and follow the steps.
settings.tgStep2: Copy the bot token BotFather gives you and send it to your developer (it is stored as a hidden server setting, never in the database).
settings.tgStep3: Come back here and press "Connect Telegram".
settings.tgConfirmRemove: Stop sending notifications to this chat?
settings.tgLinkHint: Telegram opened in a new tab — press Start there. To add someone else, send them one of these links:
settings.tgLinkExpiry: Links work once and expire after 15 minutes. Press Refresh list after connecting.
settings.tgWhatYouGet: Messages include the customer, phone, address, items, coupon and total, with a button that opens the order here.
settings.tgTestSent: {count, plural, one {Test sent to # chat} other {Test sent to # chats}}
settings.tgTestFailed: Could not send the test message.
settings.tgBadToken: The bot token is invalid — check it with BotFather.
settings.tgWebhookFailed: Telegram did not accept the webhook. Try again in a minute.
settings.analyticsDesc: Visitor statistics and Google indexing. Analytics only stores cookies after a visitor accepts the cookie banner.
settings.gaIdDesc: Analytics → Admin → Data streams → your web stream. Starts with G-. Leave empty to turn tracking off.
settings.gscDesc: Only if you verify with the "HTML tag" method: paste just the content="…" value. Not needed if you verified with DNS.

heroSlides.title: Hero Slides
heroSlides.reorderHint: Drag rows to change the order slides appear in on the homepage carousel.
heroSlides.noItemsYet: No hero slides yet. Create one to get started.
heroSlides.subheadingPlaceholder: A short line supporting the headline...
heroSlides.slideImageHint: Wide banner on desktop, taller/squarer on mobile — use "Edit crop" to set an independent focal point and zoom for each.
heroSlides.imageFocalPointLabel: Image Focal Point (fallback when no crop is set)
heroSlides.activationHint: Only enabled slides appear in the homepage carousel, in Display Order.
heroSlides.turkishHint: Shown on the Turkish site (/tr). Leave a field empty to use the English text above.

categoryTiles.title: Category Tiles
categoryTiles.reorderHint: These make up the "Find Your Category" grid on the homepage. Drag rows to change display order.
categoryTiles.noItemsYet: No category tiles yet. Create one to get started.
categoryTiles.bentoSizingHint: The homepage grid is 4 columns × 2 rows. A 2×2 tile is the large feature tile; 1×1 is a standard square. Sizes are clamped to fit.
categoryTiles.tileCropHint: After uploading, use "Edit crop" to choose which part of the photo shows in this tile — separately for desktop and mobile. The frame matches the tile size you pick below.
categoryTiles.tileCropSaved: Custom crop set — save the tile to apply it.

seasonalCollections.title: Seasonal Collections
seasonalCollections.reorderHint: Drag rows to change homepage display order.
seasonalCollections.noItemsYet: No seasonal collections yet. Create one to get started.

validation.titleMinLength: Title must be at least 2 characters

seasonalCollections.subtitlePlaceholder: e.g. Light, fresh scents for the season
seasonalCollections.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description of this collection...
seasonalCollections.productsHintBefore: Only these products will show on
seasonalCollections.schedulingHint: Even when enabled, the collection only shows while today falls within its Start/End Date window (leave either blank for no limit).
seasonalCollections.seoTitlePlaceholder: Defaults to Title if left blank
seasonalCollections.seoDescriptionPlaceholder: Defaults to Description if left blank
seasonalCollections.seoHint: Slug, canonical URL, and Open Graph image are generated automatically from the title and banner image.

products.title: Products
products.openModeBanner: Open Mode is on — edit Name, Price, Stock, Status, and Popular directly in the table below. Changes save automatically. Use "Edit Product" for brand, category, images, or description.
products.editProductDescription: Make changes to your product here. Click save when you're done.
products.confirmDeleteProduct: Are you sure you want to delete this product?
products.hasVariantsDescription: Does this product have different sizes?
products.coverImageHint: First image is the cover shown in listings and the product page. Independent desktop/mobile crop applies to it.
products.mobileImageHint: Shown on mobile instead of the cover image. Leave empty to use the cover image on mobile too.
products.permissionDeniedCategory: Permission denied: You must run the fix_rls_policies.sql script in your Supabase Dashboard to allow creating categories.
products.failedToCreateCategory: Failed to create category. See console for details.
products.errorUploadingImageBucket: Error uploading image. Make sure "products" bucket exists in Supabase Storage.

validation.nameMinLength: Name must be at least 2 characters

products.newItemDescription: Always show the New badge on this product. Recently added products get it automatically (see Settings).
products.descriptionTrPlaceholder: Turkish description — shown on the Turkish site (/tr).
products.descriptionSeoHint: Shown to Turkish visitors and used for Google in Turkish. Describe the scent family and notes in 2–4 sentences. If empty, the English text is used.

imageCrop.usesDesktopFallback: Using the desktop image (no mobile override set)

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.subtitle: Create codes for customers, or generate a batch of unique codes to hand out.
coupons.expiresAtHint: Optional. Leave empty for no expiry.
coupons.oncePerCustomerHint: The same email or phone number can use this code only once.
coupons.generatedCount: {count, plural, one {# code created} other {# codes created}}
coupons.generatedHint: {count, plural, one {# code is ready.} other {# codes are ready.}} Click a code to copy it, or copy / download them all.
coupons.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the code and copy it manually.
coupons.confirmDelete: Delete coupon {code}? Orders that used it keep their discount.
coupons.empty: No coupons yet. Create one or generate a batch.

blog.title: Blog
blog.subtitle: Write and publish articles in Turkish and English. Each language appears on the site once its title and content are filled in.
blog.empty: No posts yet. Write your first article.
blog.err_slug_required: Add a title (or a URL) first.
blog.err_needs_language: To publish, fill in the title and content for at least one language.
blog.err_slug_taken: Another post already uses this URL — change it in the SEO panel.
blog.languageHint: Switch language to write each version. A language with an empty title or content is simply not shown on the site.
blog.titlePlaceholder: e.g. How to make your perfume last longer
blog.excerptPlaceholder: One or two sentences that make people click in Google.
blog.excerptHint: Shown in Google results and on the blog list. Aim for 110–160 characters.
blog.summaryPlaceholder: Answer the main question directly in 2–4 sentences.
blog.summaryHint: Shown first on the article. Google and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini…) quote short, direct answers like this.
blog.contentPlaceholder:
## Start with a question your customers ask

Write in short paragraphs. Use ## for sections and ### for sub-sections.
blog.faqHint: 2–5 real customer questions. Shown at the end and marked up for Google.
blog.slugHint: Same address in both languages. Changing it after publishing breaks old links.
blog.snippetDescPlaceholder: Your meta description will appear here.
blog.check_questionHeading: A heading phrased as a question
blog.check_image: Cover image with descriptive alt text
blog.check_internalLinks: Links to products or shop pages ({count})
blog.publishedAtHint: Leave empty to publish now. A future date schedules the post.
blog.featuredHint: Shown large at the top of the blog.
blog.coverHint: Landscape 1600×900 works best. Also used when shared on social media.
blog.coverAltPlaceholder: e.g. Amber perfume bottle on a marble table
blog.authorBioPlaceholder: One line about the author — builds trust with readers and search engines.
blog.relatedProductsHint: Shown under the article and linked in structured data.

subscribers.title: Newsletter subscribers
subscribers.subtitle: Everyone who signed up through the form in the site footer.
subscribers.copied: {count, plural, one {# email copied} other {# emails copied}}
subscribers.confirmDelete: {count, plural, one {Remove this subscriber?} other {Remove # subscribers?}}
subscribers.deleted: {count, plural, one {Subscriber removed} other {# subscribers removed}}
subscribers.emptyHint: Signups from the footer form will appear here.

imageSpecs.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB
imageSpecs.tooSmall: smaller than recommended, may look soft on large screens
imageSpecs.shapeOff: different shape from the frame, the edges will be cut off
imageSpecs.shapeOffCrop: different shape from the frame — use “Edit crop” to choose what shows

where.product: Product cards and product page — 3:4 on desktop, 4:5 on phones. Keep the bottle centred with some space around it.
where.productMobile: Replaces the cover on phones only (4:5).
where.hero: Homepage banner — wide 2.6:1 on desktop, square on phones. Keep the subject in the middle so both crops work.
where.categoryTile: “Find your category” grid. The size follows the tile size chosen below.
where.category: Category cards — tall 4:7 on the homepage, square on the Categories page.
where.brand: Small round logo in the brand strip. Use a square logo on a plain background.
where.seasonalDesktop: Full-width seasonal banner on desktop (380–640 px tall).
where.seasonalMobile: Seasonal banner on phones. Leave empty to use the desktop banner.
where.seasonalPattern: Texture laid over the banner at low opacity. Any shape.
where.seasonalDecorative: Small decoration in the banner corner. A PNG with a transparent background works best.
where.blogCover: Blog post cover and blog cards (16:9).

imageAdjust.title: Adjust — {name}
imageAdjust.applied: Adjusted photo saved — save the form to publish it.
imageAdjust.loadFailed: This photo can't be edited here (it's hosted somewhere that blocks it). Download it and upload it again to adjust it.
imageAdjust.note: Saves an adjusted copy. The original file stays untouched, so you can always go back.
